name: Mary Fiske Stoughton House

dates.altered: The Wikipedia infobox: 'altered 1900, 1925, ca. 1970'; the Library's item record: '1883 Initial Construction', '1900 Subsequent Work', '1925 Subsequent Work'. The survey records that the 'large library, conservatory, and music room' were added in 1900 for John Fiske, that the open loggia over the front porch has been enclosed, and that the kitchen wing was converted to a garage after 1969 (Wikipedia caption).
dates.note: The node's exemplar says 1882-83 and the infobox 'Built 1882-83'; the Library's record says 1883. Kept as the infobox states it.

quotes.text: 4.Porches: Front porch measures approximately 24' x 10'. Loggia now glassed in. Kitchen stoop is a very small entry with four risers. The side entrance faces Ash Street,dates from remodeling. There is a narrow porch on that entrance. There is a rear entrance and a well entrance to the cellar. The second floor library has a porch opening off of it.
quotes.page: HABS No. MA-1033, Part II.B.4; same span

quotes.text: 5.Chimneys: All five have tall chimney potts with louvered circular vents.
